candidate_protocol: Incumbents first. Alternate shuffled saved matrix records with fresh uniform normalized signed supports, deduplicated by affine equivalence. Not an exhaustive large-order matrix search; no rectangle-cost filtering of fresh proposals.
restart_protocol: Four arithmetic/depth arms per new legal matrix at seed0. After every four new legal matrices, revisit a randomly selected member of the best-four matrix frontier with its next seed. No extra time budget per arm.
baseline: Preserve prior rectangle circuits and verified lifts of small searched circuits.
clock: Active task elapsed time, including candidate checks, construction, verification and I/O; queue excluded.
